mapper.select: SELECT mg.merchant_goods_id AS merchantGoodsId, mg.merchant_base_id AS merchantBaseId, mg.goods_name AS goodsName, mg.category AS category, mg.sub_category AS subCategory, mg.price AS price, mg.original_price AS originalPrice, mg.stock AS stock, mg.sales_count AS salesCount, mg.description AS description, mg.tag_codes AS tagCodes, mg.status AS status, mg.avg_rating AS avgRating, mg.rating_count AS ratingCount, mg.five_star_rate AS fiveStarRate, mg.four_star_rate AS fourStarRate, mg.three_star_rate AS threeStarRate, mg.two_star_rate AS twoStarRate, mg.one_star_rate AS oneStarRate, mg.create_time AS createTime, mg.update_time AS updateTime, mgi.image_url AS mainImageUrl FROM merchant_goods mg INNER JOIN -- 改为内连接，只保留有主图的商品 merchant_goods_image mgi ON mg.merchant_goods_id = mgi.merchant_goods_id AND mgi.is_main = 1 -- 关联主图 WHERE mg.status = 1 -- 只查询上架商品 ORDER BY mg.avg_rating DESC -- 按评价评分降序排序 LIMIT 10; -- 可根据实际需求调整推荐数量

SELECT sg.secondhand_goods_id AS goodsId, sg.goods_name AS goodsName, sg.category AS category, sg.price AS price, sg.description AS description, sg.status AS status, sg.view_count AS viewCount, sg.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, sg.share_count AS shareCount, sg.create_time AS createTime, -- 主图URL（若需多图可调整查询逻辑） (SELECT image_url FROM secondhand_goods_image WHERE secondhand_goods_id = sg.secondhand_goods_id AND is_main = 1 LIMIT 1) AS imageUrl -- 暂存主图，如需多图可改为关联查询 FROM secondhand_goods sg WHERE sg.status = 1 -- 只查询在售商品 ORDER BY sg.view_count DESC -- 按浏览量降序排序 LIMIT 10; -- 可根据实际需求调整推荐数量
